in_marathi.name: Ikshavi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ikshavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ikshavi is derived from the name of the goddess Ikshani, who is revered as the mother of the universe in Hindu mythology. She is believed to protect her devotees from all evils and grant them prosperity and happiness.
